title: Barfi Rolls
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

steps.instruction: -In a non-stick wok,add clarified butter,milk,sugar & milk powder.
steps.romanUrdu: -Non-stick karahi mein ghee,doodh,cheeni aur milk powder dal dein.

steps.instruction: -Turn on the flame,mix well & cook on low flame until it leaves the sides of pot (6-8 minutes).
steps.romanUrdu: -Chulha on karein,ache tarhan mix karein aur pot ki sides chornay tak paka lein (6-8 minutes).

steps.instruction: -Add desiccated coconut,cardamom powder,mix well & cook on low flame for 4-5 minutes or until soft dough is formed.
steps.romanUrdu: -Khopra aur elaichi powder dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur halki ancch per 4-5 minutes or sofy dough form ho janay tak paka lein.

steps.instruction: -Transfer the mixture on a flat working surface,wrap in a cling film & refrigerate for 10 minutes until cool down.
steps.romanUrdu: -Mixture ko flat working surface per rakh dein aur cling film mein warp ker lein aur thanda ho janay tak 10 minutes kliya refrigerator mein rakh dein.

steps.instruction: -Take 20g of mixture & make an oval shape barfi.
steps.romanUrdu: -20g mixture lein aur oval shape barfi bana lein.
-Chandi ka warq aur pista sa decorate ker ka serve karein (makes 22).
